diagnosis: The staging E2E test trace endpoint downloads network traces and HAR logs by sessionId without verifying test session ownership. Automated browser test traces capture raw HTTP traffic including session cookies, OAuth bearer tokens, and confidential customer payloads transmitted during staging runs. An attacker can download traces from other tenant test runs to extract valid authentication tokens and hijack staging accounts.
exploit_request:
GET /staging/tests/traces/sess_e2e_prodlike_checkout_8819/download HTTP/1.1
Host: e2e-hub.staging.corp
Authorization: Bearer qa_contractor_token
